key.name: position-x
key.description: Position of the widget on the desktop from 0 (left) to 1 (right).

key.name: position-y
key.description: Position of the widget on the desktop from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

key.name: language-mode
key.description: Language used by the widget. 'system': use the LC_TIME language. 'auto': use the LC_TIME language, unless the default weekday font cannot display every weekday, in which case use English. 'english': use English.

key.name: use-24h
key.description: Deprecated: replaced by time-format. Only read once to migrate the setting from older versions.

key.name: weekday-enabled
key.description: Whether the weekday is shown in the widget.

key.name: weekday-font
key.description: Font face of the weekday.

key.name: weekday-size-scale
key.description: A factor from 0 to 1 used to compute the font size of the weekday.

key.name: weekday-tracking-scale
key.description: A factor from 0 to 1 used to compute the spacing between the letters of the weekday.

key.name: weekday-color
key.description: Custom color of the weekday.

key.name: weekday-color-enabled
key.description: Whether the weekday uses its custom color instead of the system accent color.

key.name: weekday-decorations
key.description: Characters displayed on either side of the weekday.

key.name: weekday-format
key.description: Format of the weekday. 'long': full word, 'short': abbreviation.

key.name: date-enabled
key.description: Whether the date is shown in the widget.

key.name: date-font
key.description: Font face of the date.

key.name: date-size-scale
key.description: A factor from 0 to 1 used to compute the font size of the date label.

key.name: date-tracking-scale
key.description: A factor from 0 to 1 used to compute the spacing between the letters of the date label.

key.name: date-color
key.description: Custom color of the date.

key.name: date-color-enabled
key.description: Whether the date uses its custom color instead of the system accent color.

key.name: date-decorations
key.description: Characters displayed on either side of the date.

key.name: date-format
key.description: Format of the date. 'numeric': 01.09.2026, 'text': 01 SEP 2026, 'long': 01 SEPTEMBER 2026.

key.name: time-enabled
key.description: Whether the time is shown in the widget.

key.name: time-font
key.description: Font face of the time.

key.name: time-size-scale
key.description: A factor from 0 to 1 used to compute the font size of the time label.

key.name: time-tracking-scale
key.description: A factor from 0 to 1 used to compute the spacing between the letters of the time label.

key.name: time-color
key.description: Custom color of the time.

key.name: time-color-enabled
key.description: Whether the time uses its custom color instead of the system accent color.

key.name: time-decorations
key.description: Characters displayed on either side of the time.

key.name: time-format
key.description: Format of the time. '24h': 18:30, '12h': 06:30 PM.
